selection_basis: Follow-up development selection after the first prototype failed a broader output audit. Spatial verifier v4, crop gate 0.9, path evidence floor 0.15, and elongated-color rejection retain 17/18 diagnostic positive samples and repeat none of nine diagnosed errors; old development frame check 13/16 correct with zero wrong outputs. Same known-positive recall as less conservative gate 0.8 with fewer weak outputs. These diagnostics are reused for selection; they are not a final independent test. The nine-point temporal check is now reused, and 23 current-game development positives train the verifier. The 59 cross-game regression labels remain out of training and were not scored for verifier selection. A subsequent 36-point additional-position audit exposed two more shoes and a held-ball projection error. This motivated a separately recorded GPT-6 Astra review stage. Its conservative application rule was specified in vlm-protocol.json and clarified in vlm-application.json; review decisions do not create coordinates.

recall.selection_basis: Additional visual candidates only, where the conservative CV pass was unknown. A diagnostic audit found red background lights accepted as airborne balls. Restrict this weaker recovery pass to reviewed floor support and valid floor projection; do not overwrite primary points or add interpolation. Fresh output audit follows this gate selection.
